fixtureProvenance.description: One hundred explicit synthetic captured-output cases for offline evaluator contract and mutation regression testing; not an empirical model benchmark. The three unparsed-bounce reply cases are the exception: their expected category was taken from the production classifier (ChatGPT desktop, GPT-5.6 Sol, Instant), which answered `bounce` at 0.99 confidence on each, so the offline classifier is held to what production actually does. A haulier's own reply about a failed freight delivery is held to `question`, because the prospects this product writes to discuss undelivered goods for a living and a bounce classification suppresses an address permanently.
